1.0.0.en: Initial release with support for ZS-301Z Soil Sensor. Features soil moisture, soil fertility, temperature, humidity, illuminance, battery level, and water shortage alarm.

1.0.2.en: Reliably applies the configured reporting interval when battery-powered sensors wake up.
1.0.2.no: Bruker det konfigurerte rapporteringsintervallet pålitelig når batteridrevne sensorer våkner.
